definition: A settlement counts as reachable to the licensed network when a stop of an enabled, commercially licensed GTFS feed lies within 15 km straight-line. Network reach is not a verified journey: no planner query was run per settlement.
walkingGeometry: NOT_ROUTED — distances are crow-flight stop proximity, not pedestrian geometry.

hierarchy.caveat: КОАТУУ frozen at the pre-2020 administrative reform: 490 raions, no KATOTTH hromada codes. The current 136-raion / 1469-hromada layer has no open bulk registry (DATA_GAP).
